}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "BWIFI", "PCB-WIFI-AP1-1.0", "(C) 2005" appears to be silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
Per the [http://www.dd-wrt.com/wiki/index.php/Supported_Devices DD-WRT Supported Devices table], this router has 4MB Flash and 16MB RAM.
Presumed 00:14:AC ('''Bountiful WiFi''') OUI based on the FCC label. :Default credentials are per the manual.
